items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I got him with Eddie South down at Cafe Society

ctx.x: Right. A tremendous musician, a tremendous percussionist.

I said, don't worry about it. The worst thing that John Hammond could ever do - I got him with Eddie South down at Cafe Society and he played "The Sheik of Araby" and the Down Beat said, "He's going to be the successor of Jo Jones." I said, "No, never. You're a percussionist; you don't know how to play no jazz. You know more music than the musicians you're going to play with. You just stick with the drums, write your xylophone parts, write your vibraphone parts, write your chime parts, He said 'yes, but -' I…
Sticks Evans is another percussionist, young percussionist.
